clause_text: Aligned: passes financial gate + Aligned gate 2 (values link): Storytelling & education
summary: Owns DC Comics Publishing and film/TV studios.
caveat: Thin link: the 10-K only lists DC Comics Publishing as one unit of the Studios segment. Also, WBD's Q2 2026 10-Q reports a pending merger agreement with Paramount Skydance (signed after WBD terminated a Netflix merger agreement on Feb 27, 2026), so the shares may be converted in a deal.

evidence.publisher: Warner Bros. Discovery Form 10-K FY2025, Item 1 Business (SEC EDGAR)
evidence.quote: WBD's Studios segment includes the Warner Bros. Motion Picture Group ("WBMPG"), DC Studios, Warner Bros. Television Group ("WBTVG"), Consumer Products, Themed Entertainment and Brand Licensing, DC Comics Publishing

evidence.publisher: Warner Bros. Discovery Form 10-Q Q2 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
